name: LocalizationDubbingTracker
tagline: Every language version of every title – dubbing, subtitles, audio description, vendors, QC and delivery in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete localization tracker for distributors, streaming services, broadcasters, game publishers and localization vendors: plan language versions per title, track dubbing, voice-over, audio-description and subtitle tasks through translation, recording, mix, QC and delivery, score vendors and control cost against a per-minute rate card – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Title × language matrix with one chip per task
Plan all missing language versions in one step
Status workflow with allowed transitions and required data per status
Audio tasks pass Mix & conform; QC pass mark and open-issue limit
Vendor scorecard: QC average, pass rate, on-time delivery, cost vs estimate
Per-minute rate card and cost warnings
Bulk status, vendor and delete with undo; CSV export
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA support
